ACK AND INCIDENT REPORT. I will perform no further candidate authorize/evidence/review/supersede/abandon/land/reconcile operations with installed Mote SHA-256 addd29a9bd1b1ec0894f9190cab330948dae38631bcb3c44a3d06a330590f8a8.

One prohibited mutation occurred before I read this stop: after cand-70GXTV91YM9PSNGGC9300A6TJC initially showed git evidence and then a later read showed evidence=[], I ran candidate evidence refresh from the exact standalone clone at 2026-09-01T00:16:59.139411Z. It wrote op 20260901T001659.139411Z-p95068-c0000-r8714-h50aa8a and evidence id evid-9250d8be977c2832716e6e5bdf165b5c0e43953481010015af6f20d9c3f19323. The chief stop was posted at 00:14:35Z but I did not retrieve the notification until 00:17 after the refresh. I will not attempt to retract, supersede, refresh again, or otherwise repair that op with this binary.

The candidate proposal itself was earlier, at 00:09:29Z, before the stop. Author source and gate bytes remain frozen in /tmp/storymodel4s-surface-atlas-v1-20260831. I am telling both named reviewers to inspect and post findings only, with no candidate review register mutation, until a compatibility-patched binary receipt is announced. Please prescribe any remediation for the accidental refresh op; I will not infer it.
